systems.platform: video conferencing and virtual hearings, with electronic filing and digital case management on the court side
systems.owner: Malawi Judiciary, with the Malawi Police Service and Malawi Prisons Service, in partnership with UNDP and Airtel Malawi
systems.tiers: Pilot phase at go-live, April 2024: ten courts, six prisons and four police stations, the police sites being Chisenga and Nthalire Police Posts (Chitipa), Makwasa Police (Thyolo) and Jali Police Station

note: The e-Court links police stations to courts by video so that detainees can apply for bail; it is a court system and a link, and the document says nothing of how a station records a report or a case.
